title.en: Turning a story into a model you can trust
title.zh: 把一段文字变成可靠的模型

description.en: You write the model of Consolidated Electronics, of the exam’s DCI question and of a four-product factory yourself, and a checker solves your model, compares it with the problem’s by meaning, and shows a plan that breaks any limit you missed.
description.zh: 你亲手写出 Consolidated Electronics、考试里 DCI 那道题和一家四种产品工厂的模型；检查器会解你的模型，按意思和题目的模型比较，并给出一个破坏了你漏掉的限制的计划。

name.en: Formulating a linear program from a story
name.zh: 把一段文字写成线性规划

description.en: Mixing units in one limit (days with minutes, or cost with time)
description.zh: 在一条限制里混用单位（天和分钟，或者成本和时间）

description.en: Writing ≤ for a minimum or ≥ for a capacity
description.zh: 把下限写成 ≤、把容量写成 ≥

description.en: Charging purchased items for the plant’s time
description.zh: 把外购的件也算进了工厂的工时

text.en: Consolidated Electronics trains its staff with a consultant. A **teaming** program takes 3 days of the consultant’s time and costs \$10,000; a **problem-solving** program takes 2 days and costs \$8,000. In the next three months the consultant has **84 days**. The quality manager wants **at least 8** teaming programs and **at least 10** problem-solving programs; senior management wants **at least 25 programs in all**. How many of each should be offered to spend as little as possible?
text.zh: Consolidated Electronics 请一位顾问给员工做培训。一场**团队协作**培训占用顾问 3 天，花费 \$10,000；一场**问题解决**培训占用 2 天，花费 \$8,000。未来三个月顾问一共有 **84 天**。质量经理要求团队协作培训**至少 8 场**、问题解决培训**至少 10 场**；高层要求**总共至少 25 场**。每种该办几场，才能花得最少？

text.en: Any story like this is a model in disguise. Read it three times, with one question each: **What do I decide? What do I want? What stops me?**
text.zh: 这类文字都是一个伪装起来的模型。读三遍，每遍问一个问题：**我要决定什么？我想要什么？什么在限制我？**

rows.en: how many programs of each kind to offer
the **decisions**: two numbers
as little as possible; \$10,000 and \$8,000 each
the **objective**: a cost to **minimise**
the consultant has 84 days; 3 days and 2 days per program
rows.zh: 顾问有 84 天；每场 3 天、2 天

rows.en: a **capacity**: something you can use up (≤)
rows.zh: 一个**容量**：可以被用完的东西（≤）

rows.en: at least 8 teaming, at least 10 problem-solving
rows.zh: 团队协作至少 8 场、问题解决至少 10 场

rows.en: two **minimums**, one decision each (≥)
rows.zh: 两个**下限**，各针对一个决策（≥）

rows.en: at least 25 programs in all
a **minimum on a total** of both decisions (≥)
rows.zh: 针对两个决策**总和的下限**（≥）

prompt.en: “Senior management wants **at least 25 programs in all**.” Which line says that, with $x_1$ teaming and $x_2$ problem-solving programs?
prompt.zh: “高层要求**总共至少 25 场**。”设 $x_1$ 为团队协作场数、$x_2$ 为问题解决场数，哪一行说的是这个意思？

feedback.en: That caps the programs at 25. “At least” is a floor.
feedback.zh: 那是把场数限制在 25 以内。“至少”是下限。

feedback.en: That asks for 25 of each, 50 in all. The 25 counts both kinds together.
feedback.zh: 那是要求每种 25 场、共 50 场。25 是两种加在一起的数。
“至少”允许 26 或 30 场，“正好”就不允许了。

explain.en: “At least” is a minimum, so $\ge$; “in all” means the two kinds added together.
explain.zh: “至少”是下限，所以用 $\ge$；“总共”是两种相加。

alt.en: A formulation checker: choose maximise or minimise, type the objective and each limit of Consolidated Electronics, and it solves your model and compares it with the problem’s.
alt.zh: 一个模型检查器：选最大化或最小化，输入 Consolidated Electronics 的目标函数和每条限制，它会解你的模型并和题目的模型比较。

names.zh: x1 = 团队协作培训的场数
x2 = 问题解决培训的场数

caption.en: Write x1 and x2 for $x_1$ and $x_2$, and <= for ≤. A line passes when it **means** the same: another way of writing a limit is fine.
caption.zh: $x_1$、$x_2$ 写成 x1、x2，≤ 可以写 <=。只要**意思**相同就算通过：换一种写法没有关系。

text.en: The checker does not hand you the answer. It tells you what your model **allows that the problem does not** (with a plan), and what it **forbids that the problem allows**. Keep going until both lists are empty.
text.zh: 检查器不会直接给你答案。它告诉你：你的模型**允许了哪些题目不允许的东西**（并给出一个计划），以及**拒绝了哪些题目允许的东西**。改到两张清单都空了为止。

alt.en: The plan plane of Consolidated Electronics: every limit a wall, the allowed plans between them.
alt.zh: Consolidated Electronics 的计划平面：每条限制一面墙，允许的计划在墙之间。

caption.en: The orange line is a cost; thick: the allowed plans that cost exactly that. Press the button to slide it in from the expensive side.
caption.zh: 橙色线是一个成本；粗的部分：恰好花这么多、又被允许的计划。按按钮把它从贵的一边往里推。

text.en: This is lesson 1 with the signs turned round. The allowed set is **above** the minimums and **below** the consultant’s days, and the best plan is the **first** corner a cost line touches as it slides **in** from the expensive side.
text.zh: 这就是第 1 课，只是符号反过来了。允许的区域在各个下限的**上方**、顾问天数的**下方**，最优计划是成本线从贵的一边往里推时**最先**碰到的那个角。

prompt.en: The cheapest allowed plan is at the corner where “at least 8 teaming” meets “at least 25 in all”. What does it cost, in dollars?
prompt.zh: 最便宜的允许计划在“团队协作至少 8 场”和“总共至少 25 场”相交的那个角。它的成本是多少美元？

prompt.en: Senior management relaxes its minimum from 25 to 24 programs in all. By how much does the lowest cost change? (A fall is negative.)
prompt.zh: 高层把“总共至少”从 25 场放宽到 24 场。最低成本变化多少？（下降用负数。）

explain.en: The best plan moves to $(8, 16)$ and costs $80{,}000 + 128{,}000 = 208{,}000$: **8,000 less**. The senior-level limit binds, and each program it lets you drop saves the cheaper kind, \$8,000. Lesson 3 gives this number a name.
explain.zh: 最优计划移到 $(8, 16)$，成本 $80{,}000 + 128{,}000 = 208{,}000$：**少了 8,000**。高层这条限制是紧的，每放宽一场，就少办一场便宜的那种，省 \$8,000。第 3 课会给这个数起个名字。

text.en: Here is the question as it stood on the 2025 paper: Question 1, compulsory, 25 marks, of which part (i) is the model, 7 marks. Nothing is given but words and a hint about the variables.
text.zh: 下面是 2025 年试卷上这道题的原样：第 1 题，必答，25 分，其中第 (i) 问是写模型，7 分。题目只给了文字和一个关于变量的提示。

paras.en: Digital Controls, Inc. (DCI), manufactures two models of a radar gun used by police to monitor the speed of automobiles. Model A is more accurate than model B. For the next week, the company has orders for 100 units of model A and 150 units of model B. Although DCI purchases all the electronic components used in both models, the plastic cases for both models are manufactured at a DCI plant in Newark, New Jersey. Each model A case requires 4 minutes of injection-molding time and 6 minutes of assembly time. Each model B case requires 3 minutes of injection-molding time and 8 minutes of assembly time. For next week, the Newark plant has 600 minutes of injection-molding time available and 1080 minutes of assembly time available. The manufacturing cost is \$10 per case for model A and \$6 per case for model B. Depending upon demand and the time available at the Newark plant, DCI occasionally purchases cases for one or both models from an outside supplier in order to fill customer orders that could not be filled otherwise. The purchase cost is \$14 for each model A case and \$9 for each model B case. Management wants to develop a minimum cost plan that will determine how many cases of each model should be produced at the Newark plant and how many cases of each model should be purchased. (Hint: Let x11 be the number of cases of model A manufactured; x12 be the number of cases of model A purchased; x21 be the number of cases of model B manufactured; x22 be the number of cases of model B purchased.)
paras.zh: Digital Controls 公司（DCI）生产两种供警察测量汽车速度用的雷达测速枪。A 型号比 B 型号更精确。下周公司有 100 台 A 型号和 150 台 B 型号的订单。DCI 两种型号用的电子元件全部外购，但两种型号的塑料外壳都在 DCI 位于新泽西州纽瓦克的工厂生产。每个 A 型号外壳需要 4 分钟注塑时间和 6 分钟装配时间；每个 B 型号外壳需要 3 分钟注塑时间和 8 分钟装配时间。下周纽瓦克工厂有 600 分钟注塑时间和 1080 分钟装配时间可用。A 型号外壳的生产成本是每个 \$10，B 型号是每个 \$6。视需求和纽瓦克工厂的可用时间而定，DCI 有时会向外部供应商购买一种或两种型号的外壳，以完成否则无法满足的客户订单。外购价格是 A 型号每个 \$14、B 型号每个 \$9。管理层希望制定成本最低的计划，确定每种型号各应在纽瓦克工厂生产多少个外壳、各应外购多少个。（提示：设 x11 为生产的 A 型号外壳数；x12 为外购的 A 型号外壳数；x21 为生产的 B 型号外壳数；x22 为外购的 B 型号外壳数。）

paras.en: (i) Formulate the linear programming (LP) model for the DCI. (7 marks)
paras.zh: (i) 写出 DCI 的线性规划（LP）模型。（7 分）

alt.en: The formulation checker with four variables: the exam’s DCI problem.
alt.zh: 带四个变量的模型检查器：考试里的 DCI 问题。

names.en: x11 = cases of model A manufactured
names.zh: x11 = 自己生产的 A 型号件数

names.en: x12 = cases of model A purchased
names.zh: x12 = 外购的 A 型号件数

names.en: x21 = cases of model B manufactured
names.zh: x21 = 自己生产的 B 型号件数

names.en: x22 = cases of model B purchased
names.zh: x22 = 外购的 B 型号件数

caption.en: Same checker, the exam’s four variables. A purchased case needs no plant time: check that your two time limits count only the cases made.
caption.zh: 同一个检查器，考试里的四个变量。外购的件不占工厂的时间：检查你的两条时间限制是不是只算了自己生产的那些。

say.en: Say what the four numbers are, with units: cases of model A made at Newark, cases of A bought, cases of B made, cases of B bought. They cannot be negative.
say.zh: 先说清四个数是什么、单位是什么：在纽瓦克生产的 A 型号件数、外购的 A 件数、生产的 B 件数、外购的 B 件数。它们不能是负数。

say.en: The goal is the lowest cost, so minimise. Each case costs what its route costs: \$10 to make an A, \$14 to buy one; \$6 to make a B, \$9 to buy one.
say.zh: 目标是成本最低，所以最小化。每件的成本由它的来路决定：自己生产一个 A 花 \$10，外购一个花 \$14；生产一个 B 花 \$6，外购花 \$9。

say.en: Orders for model A: every case of A, made or bought, adds up to the 100 ordered.
say.zh: A 型号的订单：每一件 A，不论自己生产还是外购，加起来就是订的 100 件。

why.en: Why equals and not at least? Making or buying more than ordered only adds cost, so the cheapest plan meets the orders exactly. The paper’s own answer writes it with equals.
why.zh: 为什么是等于而不是至少？多做或多买订单以外的件只会增加成本，所以最便宜的计划正好满足订单。试卷自己的答案也写成等于。

say.en: The same for model B: 150 ordered.
say.zh: B 型号同理：订了 150 件。

say.en: Injection-molding minutes: a made A uses 4, a made B uses 3, and the plant has 600. Cases that are bought never touch the plant, so $x_{12}$ and $x_{22}$ do not appear.
say.zh: 注塑时间（分钟）：生产一个 A 用 4 分钟，一个 B 用 3 分钟，工厂一共有 600 分钟。外购的件根本不进工厂，所以 $x_{12}$ 和 $x_{22}$ 不出现。

why.en: The line most answers get wrong: adding the bought cases to the plant’s time is a unit error in disguise, because the minutes are the plant’s.
why.zh: 大多数答案会写错的一行：把外购的件也算进工厂工时，是个伪装起来的单位错误，因为这些分钟是工厂的。

say.en: Assembly minutes: 6 for each made A, 8 for each made B, 1080 available.
say.zh: 装配时间（分钟）：生产一个 A 用 6 分钟，一个 B 用 8 分钟，共有 1080 分钟。

intro.en: The model answer with the reason for every line. Check it against what you wrote.
intro.zh: 参考答案，每一行都说明理由。拿它和你自己写的对照。

outro.en: Seven marks: the variables defined; the objective; two order limits; two time limits. Write the unit beside each limit, and state “all variables are at least 0”.
outro.zh: 七分：定义变量；目标函数；两条订单限制；两条时间限制。每条限制旁边写出单位，并写明“所有变量不小于 0”。

title.en: One more, with a twist: four products
title.zh: 再来一个，有个转折：四种产品

text.en: Failsafe Electronics makes four products for aerospace firms. Each passes through four departments, and a contract fixes a **minimum** of each product. Every product has its hours per unit in the table; the profit per unit is \$9, \$12, \$15 and \$11. The goal is the largest total profit.
text.zh: Failsafe Electronics 为航天公司生产四种产品。每种产品都要经过四个车间，合同还规定了每种产品的**最低产量**。表里是每种产品在各车间的单位工时；单位利润分别是 \$9、\$12、\$15、\$11。目标是总利润最大。

rows.en: Wiring
Drilling
Assembly
Inspection
Contract minimum

alt.en: The formulation checker for Failsafe: four products, four capacities and four contract minimums.
alt.zh: Failsafe 的模型检查器：四种产品、四个容量、四个合同最低量。

caption.en: Four capacities (≤) and four minimums (≥): the sign comes from the words, one by one.
caption.zh: 四个容量（≤）和四个下限（≥）：符号逐条由文字决定。

text.en: When the checker says your model means the same, it also solves it: the best plan makes 150, 300, 200, 400 units, for a profit of \$12,350. Notice that three of the four contract minimums bind: the contracts, not the factory, set the plan.
text.zh: 检查器说你的模型意思相同时，也会把它解出来：最好的计划是各做 150, 300, 200, 400 件，利润 \$12,350。注意四个合同下限里有三个是紧的：定下计划的是合同，不是工厂。

title.en: What the model must look like to go into a solver
title.zh: 一个模型要写成什么样才能交给求解器

text.en: A solver takes every model in one shape: all the variables on the left of each limit, one number on the right. Shader’s model, in a spreadsheet and in LINDO:
text.zh: 求解器只认一种形状：每条限制的左边是所有变量，右边是一个数。Shader 的模型，放进电子表格和 LINDO 是这样：

rows.en: Changing cells
the decisions; Solver fills them in
Objective cell
profit per unit times the changing cells, summed
rows.zh: 单位利润乘以可变单元格，再求和

rows.en: One row per limit: left side
its hours per unit times the changing cells, summed
rows.zh: 每件所需工时乘以可变单元格，再求和

rows.en: One row per limit: right side
the hours available, a plain number
Solver window
set the objective, tick Max or Min, choose the changing cells, add each limit, tick “make unconstrained variables non-negative”, method Simplex LP
rows.zh: 设置目标、选 Max 或 Min、选可变单元格、逐条添加限制、勾选“使无约束变量为非负数”、方法选 Simplex LP

blocks.code:
MAX 7 X1 + 5 X2
SUBJECT TO
  4 X1 + 3 X2 <= 240
  2 X1 + X2 <= 100
END

caption.en: The same model in LINDO. In the Solve menu choose Debug (it lists errors), then Solve; for now answer No to the range question; lesson 3 uses it.
caption.zh: 同一个模型在 LINDO 里。在 Solve 菜单里先选 Debug（列出错误），再选 Solve；现在先对“是否做范围分析”回答 No，第 3 课会用到。

text.en: The Solver add-in is switched on in File, Options, Add-ins, then Data, Solver. A limit written “$x_{11}$ is at most 30% of the total” has variables on both sides, so it has to be moved into this shape first. Lesson 4 does that.
text.zh: Solver 插件在 文件、选项、加载项 里打开，之后在 数据 菜单里找到 Solver。写成“$x_{11}$ 至多占总数的 30%”的限制两边都有变量，要先整理成这种形状。第 4 课会做这件事。

rows.en: at most, no more than, available, capacity, up to
rows.zh: 至多、不超过、可用、容量、最多

rows.en: at least, minimum, no fewer than, must have
rows.zh: 至少、最少、不少于、必须有

rows.en: exactly, orders for (to be filled), must equal
rows.zh: 正好、订单（要满足）、必须等于

body.en: Every term of a limit must be in the limit’s unit. The consultant’s 84 is in days and a program takes days, so $3x_1 + 2x_2 \le 84$ works; cost in dollars never goes into it.
body.zh: 一条限制里的每一项都要是这条限制的单位。顾问的 84 是天数，每场培训用的也是天数，所以 $3x_1 + 2x_2 \le 84$ 成立；以美元计的成本绝不能写进去。

body.en: A limit counts only what uses the resource. DCI’s plant minutes are used by cases made at the plant, never by cases bought from a supplier.
body.zh: 一条限制只算会用到这项资源的东西。DCI 工厂的分钟数只被工厂自己生产的件用掉，从供应商买的件从不占用。

title.en: Say what each variable is, and state your assumptions
title.zh: 说清每个变量是什么，并写明你的假设

body.en: The paper asks for labelled answers and stated assumptions. A line such as “$x_1$ = number of teaming programs offered” costs seconds and often earns a mark. Do not forget “all variables $\ge 0$”: the checker adds it for you, the examiner does not.
body.zh: 试卷要求答案要有标注、假设要写明。像“$x_1$ = 办的团队协作培训场数”这样的一行只要几秒钟，常常能拿到一分。别忘了“所有变量 $\ge 0$”：检查器会替你加上，阅卷人不会。

prompt.en: At a problem’s best plan, one limit has 12 units of room left. What happens to the best profit if that limit’s right-hand side is raised by 5?
prompt.zh: 在某个问题的最优计划处，有一条限制还剩 12 个单位的富余。如果把这条限制的右端提高 5，最优利润会怎样？

label.en: It rises by 5 times the profit per unit of what the limit counts.
label.zh: 增加 5 乘以这条限制所计量的东西的单位利润。

feedback.en: That is what happens to a **binding** limit. This one has room, so it is not holding the plan.
feedback.zh: 那是**紧的**限制才会发生的事。这条还有富余，并没有卡住计划。

label.en: Nothing: the limit is slack, so the best plan does not move.
label.zh: 什么也不变：这条限制是松的，最优计划不动。

label.en: It falls, because the allowed set got bigger.
label.zh: 下降，因为允许的区域变大了。

feedback.en: Relaxing a limit never makes the best plan worse.
feedback.zh: 放松一条限制不会让最优计划变差。

explain.en: A slack limit has room left at the best plan, so moving its wall changes nothing. Only a binding limit moves the best plan.
explain.zh: 松的限制在最优计划处还有富余，移动它的墙什么都不变。只有紧的限制会让最优计划动。

prompt.en: A solver reports that your model is **infeasible**. You wrote “at least 40 x-pods” and “assembly allows at most 30 x-pods”. What went wrong?
prompt.zh: 求解器报告你的模型**无可行解**。你写了“x-pod 至少 40 个”和“装配最多允许 30 个 x-pod”。哪里出了问题？

label.en: Two of your limits contradict each other: no plan keeps both.
label.zh: 你的两条限制互相矛盾：没有任何计划能同时守住。

label.en: A limit is missing, so the profit has no top.
label.zh: 漏了一条限制，所以利润没有上限。

feedback.zh: 那是**无界**，是相反的毛病。

feedback.en: That is alternative optima: there is a best plan, in fact many.
feedback.zh: 那是多个最优解：有最优计划，而且不止一个。

explain.en: A minimum of 40 above a maximum of 30 leaves no plan: the allowed set is empty.
explain.zh: 下限 40 高于上限 30，就没有任何计划：允许的区域是空的。
